fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human name of this projectile (e.g. Missile, Laser, Thrown Grenade).

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Slug
fields.description: Stable id used to reference this projectile type.

fields.name: kind
fields.title: Kind
fields.description: homing = steers toward a target each tick (missile); straight = travels in a fixed line (laser); lobbed = arcs under gravity and bounces (thrown grenade).

fields.name: speed
fields.title: Speed (units/s)
fields.description: Travel speed. projectile_types.gd MISSILE_BASE_SPEED 28.0 / LASER_SPEED 30.0. Empty for lobbed (uses throw strength + gravity).

fields.name: turnRate
fields.title: Turn rate (rad/s)
fields.description: Max steering per second for homing kinds. projectile_types.gd MISSILE_BASE_TURN_RATE 1.4. 0 for straight/lobbed (no homing).

fields.name: lifetime
fields.title: Lifetime (s)
fields.description: Seconds before the projectile auto-detonates/despawns. projectile_types.gd MISSILE_LIFETIME 7.0 / LASER_LIFETIME 5.0.

fields.name: hitRadius
fields.title: Hit radius (units)
fields.description: Collision radius against the player. projectile_manager.gd PLAYER_HIT_RADIUS 1.5 (both missiles and lasers check distToPlayer < 1.5).

fields.name: damage
fields.title: Damage to player
fields.description: Damage dealt to the player on hit/detonation. projectile_types.gd MISSILE_DAMAGE 80.0 / LASER_DAMAGE 80.0. Thrown grenade is player-side (GRENADE_DETONATE_DAMAGE 450.0 to enemies).

fields.name: destroyable
fields.title: Destroyable (shootable)
fields.description: True if the player can shoot the projectile down. Missiles carry MISSILE_BASE_HP (60) + a fat collision sphere; lasers cannot be destroyed.

fields.name: vfx
fields.title: VFX
fields.description: The visual effect this projectile renders with (tint / trail / halo).
